Export a Journal-Ready Reproducibility Supplement Bundle

Source: R/bundle.R
export_capsule_bundle.Rd

Packages container specifications (Dockerfile, docker-compose.yml, Apptainer.def), the cryptographic provenance manifest (capsule.json), verification certificates (capsule_certificate.md and .html), recorded project inputs/scripts/outputs, and an auto-generated README_REPRODUCE.md peer-review guide into either a clean directory or a portable ZIP archive. Strictly enforces project-root path confinement and zip-slip safety so no path traversal (..), absolute paths, or external symlinks can enter the exported bundle.

Usage

export_capsule_bundle(
  path = ".",
  output,
  format = c("zip", "dir"),
  manifest = NULL,
  verification = NULL,
  certificate = NULL,
  include_inputs = TRUE,
  include_scripts = TRUE,
  include_outputs = TRUE,
  include_containers = TRUE,
  include_certificate = TRUE,
  platform = NULL,
  overwrite = FALSE
)

Arguments

path

Path to the project root directory. Defaults to ".".

output

Destination path for the exported ZIP archive (when format = "zip") or output directory (when format = "dir").

format

Export format: "zip" (default) or "dir".

manifest

Optional rcapsule_manifest object or path to capsule.json. If NULL, reads file.path(path, "capsule.json") when present or creates a fresh manifest via create_capsule_manifest().

verification

Optional rcapsule_verification object from verify_capsule(). When supplied and include_certificate = TRUE, automatically renders certificates into the bundle.

certificate

Optional rcapsule_certificate object from render_certificate().

include_inputs

Logical; include recorded input files (default TRUE).

include_scripts

Logical; include recorded scripts & lockfiles (default TRUE).

include_outputs

Logical; include recorded output artifacts (default TRUE).

include_containers

Logical; include Dockerfile, docker-compose.yml, and Apptainer.def, compiling any missing specs on the fly (default TRUE).

include_certificate

Logical; include Markdown and HTML verification certificates when available (default TRUE).

platform

Optional target container platform ("linux/amd64", "linux/arm64", or NULL) forwarded to container compilation and README_REPRODUCE.md.

overwrite

Logical; if FALSE (default), aborts when output already exists.

Value

An S3 object of class rcapsule_export with fields output_path, format, files, n_files, size_bytes, sha256, and capsule_id.

Examples

tmp <- tempfile("rcapsule_export_")
dir.create(tmp)
writeLines("write.csv(data.frame(x = 1:3), 'out.csv', row.names = FALSE)",
           file.path(tmp, "run.R"))
write.csv(data.frame(x = 1:3), file.path(tmp, "out.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
m <- create_capsule_manifest(tmp, outputs = "out.csv", seed = 1L)
v <- verify_capsule(m, path = tmp)
zip_out <- file.path(tempdir(), paste0(basename(tmp), "_supplement.zip"))
exp <- export_capsule_bundle(tmp, output = zip_out, manifest = m, verification = v)
exp
#> 
#> ── rcapsule Exported Supplement Bundle (zip) ───────────────────────────────────
#> • Destination: /tmp/RtmpFZcrpm/rcapsule_export_18fb7bdda9ec_supplement.zip
#> • Capsule ID: "cap_58bfd3d19d8c"
#> • Files bundled: 9 (7.5 KiB)
#> • Archive SHA-256: "37077c16e8e5"
unlink(c(tmp, zip_out), recursive = TRUE)
